description: GER - Gas Escapes Report - Shared is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. A report that was originally created as an escapes report for the regulators. It contains information on the repairs from mains, risers and services. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Engineering, Shared. Its keywords are Gas Escapes. The portal shows 2026-07-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Cadent Gas Data Sharing Agreement. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
